title: Residual Moment Fiber and Stabilizer Homomorphism
body_html:
Residual Moment Fiber and Stabilizer Homomorphism

Let \[ X_{\lambda,\lambda'}=M^{-1}(\lambda)\ \text{with}\ M'=-\lambda' \] inside the residual quotient \(X\). Then \(X_{\lambda,\lambda'}\) is an \(S_\lambda\)-orbit. There is a homomorphism \[ \alpha:S_{\lambda'}\to S_\lambda \] whose graph stabilizes a chosen point \(\bar w\) in the fiber. Outside the exceptional ramified unitary equal-rank case, the \(S_\lambda\)-action is free and the stabilizer is exactly this graph. In the exceptional case, a smaller stabilizer imposes the character-triviality condition.
proof_html: Appendix 2 transfers the calculation to the Kac-Vinberg finite-field model. When the moment-map value has full rank, Witt's theorem gives a single free orbit and uniqueness gives the stabilizer graph. In the exceptional rank-deficient unitary case, explicit matrix ranks show the orbit is still controlled by \(S_\lambda\), but the stabilizer is nontrivial on the image of the residual operator.
